    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    line_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    if not line_rows:

    lr = line_rows[0]

           if grid[r][c] != bg and r != lr]
    if not obj:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    minr = min(r for r, c, value in obj)
    maxr = max(r for r, c, value in obj)
    if maxr < lr:
        new_minr = lr - 1 - (maxr - minr)
    elif minr > lr:
        new_minr = lr + 1
    else:

    shift = new_minr - minr
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
